# ISLA Builders

> Full-service general contractor in Marathon, Florida Keys (FL 33050), blending over a decade of local expertise with Cuban-heritage craftsmanship. Specialties: concrete spalling repair, concrete resurfacing and restoration, remodeling, impact windows and doors, new construction, and permit handling for Monroe County.

Contact: Jaasiel@ISLABuilders.com · (305) 395-0401 · https://www.islabuilders.com/contact (free quote form and online booking)

## Services
- [Spalling Repair](https://www.islabuilders.com/spalling): expert concrete restoration for salt-air damage — engineering plans, permits, and repair handled end-to-end
- [Concrete Resurfacing](https://www.islabuilders.com/concrete-resurfacing): resurfacing systems that bond to existing slabs with durable, non-porous finishes
- [Permits](https://www.islabuilders.com/permits): engineering plans, permit applications, county coordination, and inspections
- [Projects gallery](https://www.islabuilders.com/projects): photos of completed spalling, concrete, foundation, remodeling, siding, and fencing work
